title: Final Check · Weeks 9–12
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1. The hotel was expensive. ___, the view was amazing. (Nevertheless / Plus)
2. I would be grateful ___ you could send me a price list.
3. I look forward to ___ (hear) from you.
4. Could you ___ me a favour?
5. I ___ a terrible mistake in the test yesterday.
6. Don't take your health ___ granted.
7. People tend ___ (speak) too fast when they are nervous.
8. It could ___ argued that exams are unfair.
9. ___, the plan is expensive; even so, it is worth trying. (Moreover / Admittedly)
10. On ___, I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1. أكتب إليكم لأشكو من الخدمة في الفندق.
2. شارك أكثر من مائتي فنان في المهرجان.
3. يبدو أن الجمهور استمتع بالعرض.
4. أفهم وجهة نظرك، لكني لا أتفق معك.
5. وهذا يقودني إلى نقطتي الأخيرة.
answers: 1. I am writing to complain about the service at the hotel.
2. More than two hundred artists took part in the festival.
3. The audience seems to have enjoyed the show. / The audience seemed to enjoy the performance.
4. I see / understand your point, but I don't agree / I disagree with you.
5. This brings me to my final point.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
items: 1) culture shock = __________
2) a masterpiece = __________
3) stage fright = __________
4) a counter-argument = __________
5) to some extent = __________

sections.title: D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can write a formal email of complaint and tell the same story informally to a friend.
☐ I can review an exhibition, film or concert using natural collocations and idioms.
☐ I can give a short presentation and soften my claims politely.
☐ I can take part in a debate: agree, disagree, concede and answer a counter-argument.

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
